learned_rules: n8n Community Jobs category threads have public replies locked; applicants must apply via direct message or external contact.
Brand new Discourse accounts (TL0) have hidden profile DMs restricted; direct LinkedIn connection note to founders provides immediate bypass.
Gemini v1beta models can output unescaped literal newlines in long JSON strings; robust regex fallback parser is required.
Discourse Jobs category threads require direct founder LinkedIn outreach for rapid response.
Maintaining disciplined cadence on scheduled platform audits prevents algorithmic drift and ensures optimal inbound conversion across Fiverr and Contra.
